latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Free for YouTube.

- Instantly create and export polished YouTube videos via AI—just upload clips and describe your edit.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM format.
- Automated intro, transitions, background music, and 1080p export with minimal input.
- Cloud-based processing—no local software or editing skills required.
- Handles all YouTube-ready export with quick turnaround (1–2 minutes for short clips).
- Includes session management, credit system, and staged workflow with clear user feedback.
